periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, slanting approximately 45 to 50 degrees downwards toward the medial snout axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval morphology, with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct tapering at the inferior margin, extending significantly below the horizontal geometric center of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curvature across the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 35-40% of the visible upper-to-mid torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between pinnae, approximately 1.8 to 2 times the lateral width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior margins of the ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized rufous/brownish chromatic variance in the fur across the lower pelvic region and inner hind limbs.
